value.eventDescription: ⚾🎀 A day at the ballpark for a great cause. The bats were swinging and the community came together as Town of Brookhaven Supervisor Dan Panico, his son Grant, and 3rd District Councilman Neil Manzella took the field during the annual Celebrity Softball Charity Game in Ronkonkoma to help raise money for breast cancer research and awareness. Hosted by the Ronkonkoma Chamber of Commerce, the event brought together local leaders, community members, and supporters for a fun-filled afternoon with an important purpose. Thanks to the generosity of everyone involved, thousands of dollars were raised to support research and treatment in the fight against a disease that touches so many families. Congratulations to the celebrity team on their one-run victory—and thank you to everyone who helped make this event another success. Watch the latest Brookhaven Today for highlights from the game and hear why supporting the fight against breast cancer means so much to those who participated. #BrookhavenToday #BrookhavenTown #BreastCancerAwareness #CommunityStrong #CharitySoftball #DanPanico #NeilManzella

value.eventDescription: 🐶🐱 Protect your pets. Protect your family. The Town of Brookhaven Animal Shelter, in partnership with the Suffolk County Department of Health, is helping keep our community safe by offering free monthly rabies vaccinations throughout the summer. So far this year, the Town has vaccinated 603 dogs, 139 cats, and 3 ferrets, helping protect pets from a disease that continues to affect wildlife across Long Island. Each year, hundreds of rabid wild animals—including raccoons, skunks, bats, and feral cats—are caught or observed, making vaccination one of the most important steps pet owners can take. Town Veterinarian Dr. Ashley Caruana reminds residents that dogs must be on a leash, while cats and ferrets must be brought in a carrier. Watch the latest Brookhaven Today to learn more about the program, hear from Dr. Caruana, and see how the Animal Shelter is working to keep Brookhaven's pets healthy and protected. 📍 For upcoming clinic dates and information, visit BrookhavenNY.gov or call 631-451-TOWN. #BrookhavenToday #BrookhavenTown #RabiesClinic #PetSafety #AnimalShelter #ResponsiblePetOwnership #LongIslandPets

🌮🚚 Food Truck Thursdays are here!
Looking for a delicious way to spend a summer evening? Join the Town of Brookhaven every Thursday through September 3, from 4:00–8:00 PM, at Holtsville Park (249 Buckley Road, Holtsville) for Food Truck Thursdays!
Enjoy a variety of local food trucks just steps from the Olympic-sized pool, kiddie pool, playground, walking trail, pavilion, and more. It's the perfect place to grab dinner, spend time with family, and enjoy everything Holtsville Park has to offer.
Supervisor Dan Panico invites everyone to come out and support local food vendors while making the most of summer in Brookhaven.
📍 Thursdays • 4–8 PM • Through September 3
#BrookhavenToday #BrookhavenTown #FoodTruckThursdays #HoltsvillePark #SupportLocal #SummerInBrookhaven

value.eventDescription: 🎒📚 Help a child start the school year ready to succeed. The Town of Brookhaven, through its Youth Bureau and INTERFACE Program, is once again hosting its annual Backpack Giveaway to provide local students in need with new backpacks and school supplies before the start of the school year. Last year, thanks to the incredible generosity of residents, businesses, and community partners, more than 1,600 backpacks were distributed through 19 organizations and directly to local families. Supervisor Dan Panico encourages anyone who is able to donate or sponsor the program, helping ensure every child has the tools they need to begin the school year with confidence. If your family needs assistance, or if you'd like to contribute to this important community effort, visit BrookhavenNY.gov or call 631-451-TOWN. Together, we can help Brookhaven students start the school year prepared and ready to learn. #BrookhavenToday #BrookhavenTown #BackToSchool #BackpackDrive #CommunityStrong #YouthBureau #INTERFACE #DanPanico

value.eventDescription: 🥕🍅 Fresh food. Strong community. Caring neighbors. The Town of Brookhaven was proud to host its annual Free Farmers Market for Seniors, providing fresh, nutritious produce to older residents at no cost. Made possible through the generosity of PSEG Long Island and Long Island Cares, the event helped ensure seniors had access to healthy food while bringing the community together in the spirit of giving. Supervisor Dan Panico and Deputy Supervisor Neil Foley joined volunteers and community partners to help distribute food and thank residents for attending. The Town extends its sincere appreciation to PSEG Long Island, Long Island Cares, and everyone who volunteered to make this event another success. Together, we're helping ensure our seniors have the support they deserve. Watch the latest Brookhaven Today for highlights from this special community event. #BrookhavenToday #BrookhavenTown #CommunityStrong #SeniorServices #LongIslandCares #PSEGLongIsland #DanPanico #NeilFoley

value.eventDescription: All aboard! The new Yaphank–Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL) LIRR Station is officially open. Designed to better serve residents, commuters, and Brookhaven National Laboratory employees, the station features ADA accessibility, enhanced lighting and security, bike racks, parking, and a Kiss & Ride drop-off area. Supervisor Dan Panico joined County Executive Ed Romaine and MTA officials to celebrate the opening of this important transportation investment, completed on time and under budget. Watch the latest Brookhaven Today for highlights from the grand opening and ceremonial first ride. #BrookhavenToday #BrookhavenTown #LIRR #YaphankBNL #PublicTransportation #DanPanico #EdRomaine
